output.summary: The decline is best explained by the temporary venue move, not repertoire. Single-ticket sales fell 45% in the first season at Brightwater, and lapsed patrons cite travel (41%). Downtown cathedral concerts sold far more per concert with the same price bands. Post-1945 repertoire shows no per-concert sales penalty (1,034 vs 1,019). Core subscriber renewal is stable at about 85%. Regional peers without a venue change fell a median 29%, so the size of the decline is typical, but this does not show the venue effect is absent. Marketing effectiveness is unmeasured. Dropping the music director would lapse $400k per season of grant funding, and cutting commissions would breach the New Works grant. Recommended: separate the artistic review from the revenue question, secure downtown dates and a shuttle, and gather attribution and travel data before any marketing or personnel change.
